text: Hello, I'm Georgie.
And I'm Phil.
Welcome to Real Easy English.
Find all the vocabulary and a worksheet
to test what you've learned over on our website.
zh: 找到所有词汇和一份测验讲义，检验你的学习成果。
zh_hant: 找到所有詞彙和一份測驗講義，檢驗你的學習成果。

text: Go to bbclearningenglish.com.
Hi Phil.
How are you doing?
I'm doing really well, Georgie.
I must say, your hair is looking fantastic today.
zh: 我得说，你今天的发型看起来太棒了。
zh_hant: 我得說，你今天的髮型看起來太棒了。

text: Thank you very much, Phil.
Today we are talking about hair.
Now, I can see your hair,
but for our listeners maybe
zh: 但为了让我们的听众也了解，
zh_hant: 但為了讓我們的聽眾也瞭解，

text: you can start by describing your hair.
zh: 你可以先描述一下你的头发。
zh_hant: 你可以先描述一下你的頭髮。

text: OK.
Well, my hair – it's short,
but it's not very short.
I think it's fairly straight.
And then the colour – it's kind of a light brown colour.
zh: 颜色的话，是那种浅棕色。
zh_hant: 顏色的話，是那種淺棕色。

text: The bits that aren't grey, that is!
You said your hair used to be ginger .
zh: 你说过你的头发以前是姜黄色的。
zh_hant: 你說過你的頭髮以前是薑黃色的。

text: Yes, it used to be ginger – bright orange.
zh: 是的，以前是姜黄色的——鲜亮的橙色。
zh_hant: 是的，以前是薑黃色的——鮮亮的橙色。

text: Wow!
Well, my hair is naturally dark brown.
zh: 那我的头发天生是深棕色的。
zh_hant: 那我的頭髮天生是深棕色的。

text: It's quite short and it's
wavy ,
so sometimes it can be curly ,
but mostly it's wavy .
zh: 但大多时候是波浪状的。
zh_hant: 但大多時候是波浪狀的。

text: OK.
So, you've told us about your hair, Georgie.
zh: 那你已经跟我们说了你的头发情况，Georgie。
zh_hant: 那你已經跟我們說了你的頭髮情況，Georgie。

text: Do you like it?
Yes, I do now.
I actually...
When I was younger, I didn't really like my hair
zh: 我小时候不太喜欢自己的头发，
zh_hant: 我小時候不太喜歡自己的頭髮，

text: because I wanted it to be straight,
so I used to straighten it – take the curls and the waves out.
zh: 以前我常把头发拉直——把卷发和波浪都弄直。
zh_hant: 以前我常把頭髮拉直——把卷發和波浪都弄直。

text: But as I've got older, I've started to really like my hair.
zh: 但随着年纪增长，我开始真的喜欢上自己的头发了。
zh_hant: 但隨著年紀增長，我開始真的喜歡上自己的頭髮了。

text: It looks a bit wild and I enjoy it.
zh: 它看起来有点野性，我很喜欢这种感觉。
zh_hant: 它看起來有點野性，我很喜歡這種感覺。

text: What about you?
How do you...
Do you like your hair?
Yeah, usually I do.
I think similar to you.
When I was a teenager, I just wanted my hair to look
zh: 我十几岁的时候，就想让自己的头发看起来
zh_hant: 我十幾歲的時候，就想讓自己的頭髮看起來

text: different,
so I used to try and stick hair gel in it
zh: 所以我以前会往头发里抹发胶，
zh_hant: 所以我以前會往頭髮裡抹髮膠，

text: and try and make it do things
that it didn't want to do and it wasn't going to do.
zh: 它本来不想也不会做的造型。
zh_hant: 它本來不想也不會做的造型。

text: And I used to get very frustrated about that.
And then as you get older and wiser,
zh: 后来随着年纪增长、心态成熟，
zh_hant: 後來隨著年紀增長、心態成熟，

text: you realise actually it looks fine.
zh: 你会发现其实它看起来还不错。
zh_hant: 你會發現其實它看起來還不錯。

text: And I quite...
I quite like it.
I don't get my hair cut that often,
so it often gets a bit too long and messy
zh: 所以它常常会变得太长、太乱，
zh_hant: 所以它常常會變得太長、太亂，

text: for me.
And then when I can't put up with it any longer, I go and get it cut.
zh: 等我实在忍不下去了，就去剪掉。
zh_hant: 等我實在忍不下去了，就去剪掉。

text: And how do you feel about the hairdresser?
zh: 那你对理发师这件事感觉怎么样？
zh_hant: 那你對理髮師這件事感覺怎麼樣？

text: Do you like the experience?
I don't mind it.
It's not...
it's not something I really like doing but I don't really mind it.
zh: 这不是我特别喜欢做的事，但我也不介意。
zh_hant: 這不是我特別喜歡做的事，但我也不介意。

text: I don't have a problem with it and it does feel good to come out
zh: 我对此没什么问题，剪完出来的感觉确实挺好的，
zh_hant: 我對此沒什麼問題，剪完出來的感覺確實挺好的，

text: and it's a lot neater than it was when you went in.
Yeah.
How long does a usual appointment take
zh: 你去理发店一般要花多长时间？
zh_hant: 你去理髮店一般要花多長時間？

text: when you go to the hairdresser?
It depends how busy it is,
but if it's quiet,
I can probably go in 20–30 minutes and it's done.
zh: 我大概20到30分钟就能剪完。
zh_hant: 我大概20到30分鐘就能剪完。

text: Wow.
What about you?
Well, I think my experience of the hairdresser is a little bit different.
zh: 我的理发经历跟大家有点不太一样。
zh_hant: 我的理髮經歷跟大家有點不太一樣。

text: If I get a haircut
and a hair dye – so,
a hair dye is when you change the colour –
it can take about three hours.
But I actually enjoy it.
zh: 但我其实挺享受这个过程。
zh_hant: 但我其實挺享受這個過程。

text: I probably go to the hairdresser
once every six months,
and when I go, it's like a treat.
zh: 每次去都像是一种享受。
zh_hant: 每次去都像是一種享受。

text: OK.
You told us about the hairdresser's, Georgie.
Do you often change your hairstyle?
Well, when I was at university,
I once dyed
my hair – not all of it,
but half of it pink and green.
zh: 只是一半染成了粉色和绿色。
zh_hant: 只是一半染成了粉色和綠色。

text: But the dye , the hair dye , wasn't permanent.
zh: 但那种染发剂不是永久性的。
zh_hant: 但那種染髮劑不是永久性的。

text: It was temporary, so the colour didn't stay,
zh: 是临时性的，颜色没能留住，
zh_hant: 是臨時性的，顏色沒能留住，

text: which was probably good for me.
zh: 这对我来说可能反而是好事。
zh_hant: 這對我來說可能反而是好事。

text: I don't think I suited it.
zh: 我觉得那种颜色不太适合我。
zh_hant: 我覺得那種顏色不太適合我。

text: But recently I actually have thought
zh: 不过最近我确实在考虑
zh_hant: 不過最近我確實在考慮

text: about growing my hair,
so I want to grow it, make it a bit longer
and I want to stop dyeing it as well.
So, in the last few years
I have been dyeing my hair a bit blonder ,
zh: 我一直把头发染得更金一些，
zh_hant: 我一直把頭髮染得更金一些，

text: but I was looking at some old photos of me when I had brown, natural hair,
zh: 不过我看了一些我以前的老照片,那时候我留着棕色的天然头发,
zh_hant: 不過我看了一些我以前的老照片,那時候我留著棕色的天然頭髮,

text: and I think I'd like to go back to it.
zh: 我觉得我想回到那个样子。
zh_hant: 我覺得我想回到那個樣子。

text: Yeah.
What about you?
I don't think
I'm going to change my hair.
Do you think green would suit?
Phil, I think you would look great with green hair.
zh: Phil，我觉得你留绿色头发会很好看。
zh_hant: Phil，我覺得你留綠色頭髮會很好看。

text: Maybe.
we should try that, because my hair is changing its colour itself.
zh: 我们该试试，因为我的头发正在自己变色。
zh_hant: 我們該試試，因為我的頭髮正在自己變色。

text: It's going greyer and greyer and greyer.
And every time I get my hair cut, more grey comes off.
zh: 每次剪头发，都会掉更多灰白的头发。
zh_hant: 每次剪頭髮，都會掉更多灰白的頭髮。

text: Ah, well, maybe green would be...
...the way forward!
Yeah.
The other thing is there's less of it.
zh: 另一个问题是头发越来越少了。
zh_hant: 另一個問題是頭髮越來越少了。

text: When I get my hair cut, I can see it's higher up,
zh: 每次剪头发的时候，我都能看到发际线又高了一点，
zh_hant: 每次剪頭髮的時候，我都能看到髮際線又高了一點，

text: and there's a bit going a little bit bald there,
but hopefully no one notices.
Let's recap the language we heard during the conversation.
zh: 让我们回顾一下这次对话中学到的语言点。
zh_hant: 讓我們回顧一下這次對話中學到的語言點。

text: If you dye your hair,
and that's spelt 'D-Y-E',
then you use chemicals to change the colour.
zh: 那就是用化学药剂改变头发的颜色。
zh_hant: 那就是用化學藥劑改變頭髮的顏色。

text: hair is a light colour, a bit like yellow.
zh: blonde指的是浅色头发，有点像黄色。
zh_hant: blonde指的是淺色頭髮，有點像黃色。

text: hair is a bit like orange.
zh: ginger指的是有点像橙色的头发。
zh_hant: ginger指的是有點像橙色的頭髮。

text: If your hair is curly or wavy , it's
not straight.
It has curves.
And if you're bald , you don't have any hair on your head.
zh: 而如果你是bald，就是说你头上没有头发。
zh_hant: 而如果你是bald，就是說你頭上沒有頭髮。

text: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 这就是本期Real Easy English的全部内容。
zh_hant: 這就是本期Real Easy English的全部內容。

text: We'll be back next week
with another conversation in easy English.
And don't forget to test what you've learned
zh: 别忘了检验一下你学到的内容，
zh_hant: 別忘了檢驗一下你學到的內容，

text: with the free worksheet on our website.
zh: 去我们网站上下载免费讲义。
zh_hant: 去我們網站上下載免費講義。

text: Go to bbclearningenglish.com.
Bye for now.
Goodbye!
